phrase: a Shikanji and Drink Premix Brand
verdict: Yes. Jain Shikanji from Modinagar pitched instant shikanji powder and premixes on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal from four sharks. Premixes solve the beverage freight problem: powders are light, cheap to ship and last for months.
angle: Shikanji, jaljeera and nimbu pani are familiar Indian summer drinks with no dominant national brand. Powder premixes sell to homes, restaurants, dhabas and events. Shelf life is long, freight is cheap and one sachet can be priced low enough for impulse buying.
